title: Access: Enable zoom magnification to Microsoft Access for Forms, Tables, Queries
description: Access will add magnification slider (10% to 500%) in lower right of the application, similar to the feature in Word, PowerPoint, and Excel. It will also be keyboard accessible and available on the ribbon in Access forms, tables, and queries.
